quoted.text: This is the problem with Holland and the EU. The way you have to comply with all sort of crazy regulations, and on top of that all kinds of rules where not following them will lead to being accountable personally will deter many people from actually trying out. Look at SpaceX: most of the earlier stuff was a failure, that’s how you learn. You need to do crazy stuff, to fail, in order to learn. Sadly, that’s not happening anymore.
quoted.text_zh: 这就是荷兰和欧盟的问题。你得遵守各种疯狂的监管，再加上各种各样的规则——不遵守就会被追究个人责任——这会让很多人根本不敢去尝试。看看 SpaceX：它早期的很多东西都失败了，而这正是学习的方式。你需要去做疯狂的事情、去失败，才能学会。可惜，这种情况已经不再发生了。

posts.text:
How do I tell the @Hetzner_Online and @digitalocean CEOs to make new VPS servers:
- have a default firewall that closes all their ports
- by default have Tailscale installed as the only way to access it via SSH
- by default have some web tunnel like Cloudflare Tunnel to serve web traffic safely

That way VPS servers could get a better reputation instantly by being safe by default

It's crazy in 2026 they let you create a VPS that by default is open to the entire internet!
posts.text_zh:
我该怎么跟 @Hetzner_Online 和 @digitalocean 的 CEO 说，让他们把新的 VPS 服务器做成：
- 默认开启防火墙，关掉所有端口
- 默认安装 Tailscale，并且只允许通过它用 SSH 访问
- 默认配置某种 web tunnel，比如 Cloudflare Tunnel，用来安全地对外提供 web 服务

这样 VPS 服务器就能立刻因为默认安全而获得更好的口碑

到了 2026 年，他们居然还让你创建一个默认就对整个互联网开放的 VPS，真是疯了！

posts.text:
So many times I have had this interaction with normies where they don't understand what the jackfriks I'm working on as I'm just making random things for fun and messing around with things

And to them whatever I'm doing looks like a complete and utter waste of time, it has no function, no direct rewards, it's not making money, it's not successful

But so many times those projects evolve or lead to things where there is a massive payout or success after

But most people don't have the ability to see that far ahead, and they're risk averse so even if you tell them "I don't know maybe this becomes something, or maybe not, it doesn't really matter" that's simply too uncertain enough for them to accept. Which is of course why they love employment so much, it's stable and certain.

The problem with normies is that they will quickly shut this creative play down in themselves and even worse in others. And that way whatever that thing is, it won't ever grow into anything because they killed it before it ever got a chance, proving their point

Almost all my projects started by just messing around with no real goal, just playing for fun

But it requires some kind of peacefulness because the moment you start putting a requirement of success on to something new, the thing instantly dies

Creativity is really magical, and it messes with you if you try control it or expect things from it
posts.text_zh:
我曾经无数次跟普通人（normies）有过这样的互动：他们搞不懂我到底在捣鼓些什么 jackfriks，因为我不过是在随便做点好玩的东西、到处折腾。

在他们看来，我做的这一切完全是在浪费时间：没有用处，没有直接回报，不赚钱，也不算成功。

但很多次，这些项目后来都会演变，或通向某种巨大的回报或成功。

可大多数人没有能力看得那么远，而且他们厌恶风险，所以哪怕你告诉他们「我也不知道，也许这会变成点什么，也许不会，其实也没什么关系」，这对他们来说也实在太不确定了，让他们无法接受。这当然也是他们如此热爱上班打工的原因——稳定、确定。

普通人（normies）的问题在于，他们会很快掐灭自己身上这种创造性的玩耍，更糟的是还会掐灭别人的。这样一来，那件事情永远长不成任何东西，因为他们在它还没机会之前就把它杀死了，从而「证明」了自己是对的。

我几乎所有的项目，一开始都只是在瞎玩，没有真正的目标，纯粹为了好玩。

但这需要某种平静，因为一旦你开始给新事物加上「必须成功」的要求，它立刻就死了。

创造力真的很神奇，你一旦试图控制它、或对它抱有期待，它就会跟你作对。
